The subscription should be the single authority on a workspace's plan. The billing page shows Growth, but the workspace still behaves like Free. Project creation and seat invitations are blocked. The audit-log export and workspace switcher also remain on Free.

The refill formula preserves existing tokens from the old plan. A bucket that held 59 tokens after the free limit is exhausted will keep those 59 until time passes. The growth plan refills at 2000 tokens per minute.

The cleanest immediate fix is to delete all of an organization's rate-limit buckets inside setOrgPlan whenever the plan changes. Another option is to track the last resolved plan per organization and reset the bucket on the next consume if the plan has changed.
